description: Update canonical place profile fields and retained compatibility notes. The place name commits to SQLite first and refreshes project backups; associated_characters and tags are compatibility/review metadata only. Use connect_character_place_evidence when scene-backed character/place evidence is paired, or connect_scene_place_evidence when scene evidence is place-only.

fields.description: Fields to update. Only supplied keys are changed.

place_id.description: The place_id to update (e.g. 'place-harbor-district'). Use list_places to find valid IDs.
